*.power: The receiver's on/standby switch: the name and the switch.power role are the whole statement.
*.multiroom.*.power: The same switch once per zone; nothing about it changes below the zone folder.
*.mute: Silences the zone — the name and the mute role say all there is to say.
*.multiroom.*.mute: The same mute once per zone, Zone B included; the name carries it there too.
*.input: The source the zone listens to, from the receiver's own input list where it declares one, else from the inputs it proves it has.
*.multiroom.*.input: The same source selection once per zone, from the same declared or proven list.
info.devicesTotal: How many devices are configured — a plain count, and the name is the count's name.
info.devicesOnline: How many of them answer right now — the same plain count.
info.devicesAllOnline: True when the two counts above are equal, which is exactly what the name says.
*.info.model: Plain identification of the hardware: the model name the receiver reports.
*.info.ip: Plain identification of the hardware: the address the adapter talks to.
*.info.firmware: Plain identification of the hardware: the firmware version the receiver reports.
*.info.transports.xml: One flag per protocol; the transports channel carries the explanation for the whole folder.
*.info.transports.ynca: One flag per protocol; the transports channel carries the explanation for the whole folder.
*.info.transports.yxc: One flag per protocol; the transports channel carries the explanation for the whole folder.
*.player.album: Track metadata as the playing source delivers it; the name is the field.
*.player.artist: Track metadata as the playing source delivers it; the name is the field.
*.player.track: Track metadata as the playing source delivers it; the name is the field.
*.player.station: The station name a radio source delivers; the name is the field.
*.player.playback: Playing, paused or stopped — the value list on the datapoint names every state.
*.player.repeat: The repeat mode, every value named in its list; the toggle button beside it explains how it is changed.
*.player.shuffle: Shuffle on or off; the toggle button beside it explains how it is changed.
*.player.play: A transport key whose name IS its function, behaving exactly as its button role promises.
*.player.pause: A transport key whose name IS its function, behaving exactly as its button role promises.
*.player.stop: A transport key whose name IS its function, behaving exactly as its button role promises.
*.player.next: A transport key whose name IS its function, behaving exactly as its button role promises.
*.player.prev: A transport key whose name IS its function, behaving exactly as its button role promises.
*.player.bluetooth.connect: A key whose name IS its function: connect the paired source.
*.player.bluetooth.connected: Whether a Bluetooth source is connected, in the folder that names the protocol.
*.player.bluetooth.deviceName: The name of the paired source, which is what the datapoint is called.
*.player.bluetooth.pairing: A key whose name IS its function: put the receiver into pairing mode.
*.player.bluetooth.pairingCancel: A key whose name IS its function: stop pairing again.
*.multiroom.*.player.album: The same now-playing field once per zone.
*.multiroom.*.player.artist: The same now-playing field once per zone.
*.multiroom.*.player.track: The same now-playing field once per zone.
*.multiroom.*.player.station: The same now-playing field once per zone.
*.multiroom.*.player.playback: The same playback state once per zone, with the same value list.
*.multiroom.*.player.repeat: The same repeat mode once per zone, with the same value list.
*.multiroom.*.player.shuffle: The same shuffle flag once per zone.
*.multiroom.*.player.play: The same transport key once per zone; its name IS its function.
*.multiroom.*.player.pause: The same transport key once per zone; its name IS its function.
*.multiroom.*.player.stop: The same transport key once per zone; its name IS its function.
*.multiroom.*.player.next: The same transport key once per zone; its name IS its function.
*.multiroom.*.player.prev: The same transport key once per zone; its name IS its function.
*.player.browse.back: Steps one menu level up; the browse channel explains the surface it belongs to.
*.player.browse.home: Jumps to the top of the menu, which is what the name Menu root already says.
*.tuner.band: Which broadcast band is tuned, with the bands the device supports as its value list.
*.tuner.frequency: The unit on the datapoint is the whole statement: every band reports kilohertz.
*.tuner.presetUp: A key whose name IS its function: on to the next stored station.
*.tuner.presetDown: A key whose name IS its function: back to the previous stored station.
*.sound.signal.format: The receiver's own wording about the incoming stream; the signal channel explains the folder.
*.sound.signal.sampling: The receiver's own wording about the incoming stream; the signal channel explains the folder.
*.sound.signal.bits: The receiver's own wording about the incoming stream; the signal channel explains the folder.
*.sound.equalizer.low: One band of the graphic equalizer; its name and the range the device declares are the whole control.
*.sound.equalizer.mid: One band of the graphic equalizer; its name and the range the device declares are the whole control.
*.sound.equalizer.high: One band of the graphic equalizer; its name and the range the device declares are the whole control.
*.multiroom.group.name: The name the MusicCast app gave the group; the group channel explains the group itself.
*.multiroom.group.serverZone: Which zone of the server feeds the group — the name already says it in full.
